authority: Root scientific policy explicitly permits selecting an original author-reported empirical predictive/method endpoint while retaining broader biological reproduction separately. Construction authorization is not execution or scientific qualification.
selected_scope: Complete original Figure 2d facial-feature decoding from AM, PR and TP responses across all source time windows: 1,000 unfamiliar-face leave-one-out folds, each using the other 999 unfamiliar faces for training and querying the omitted unfamiliar face plus all 36 familiar faces; retain all source populations and ten stimulus-identity-shuffled controls.
source_figure_or_table: Figure 2d; supplementary methods, Face feature decoding and reconstruction

source_paper.title: Temporal multiplexing of perception and memory codes in IT cortex

strongest_relevant_author_comparator: Original Figure 2d linear-regression decoder is the relevant author comparator. Its complete numerical curves and original panel reduction remain unrecovered; no geometry RMSE or other decoder panel supplies this baseline.

target.description: Predict original facial-feature vectors from the original repeat-averaged neural responses, separately for unfamiliar and familiar face queries under Figure 2d. The selected output is feature-vector correlation, not familiarity/identity classification, geometry separation or reconstruction MSE.

dataset.description: Original response and face-feature arrays released in Zenodo 10460607 version 1. Exact Figure 2d archive member/face/neuron/time identities and publication equivalence remain unresolved; merely having the axis-geometry archive does not authenticate the decoding inputs.

cohort.description: All original AM, PR and TP Figure 2d neural populations, source animals/sessions, 1,000 unfamiliar faces and 36 familiar faces. Recover exact neurons and stimulus-set/repetition joins; AM134/PR72/TP197 geometry counts and PR76 in another panel cannot be silently adopted as the decoder roster.

split.description: Use all 1,000 source leave-one-unfamiliar-face-out folds: 999 unfamiliar training faces, one omitted unfamiliar query and 36 familiar queries in every fold. Preserve all ten identity-shuffled control repetitions and their mapping. No 964/36/36 geometry sampling, half-trial identity split or newly selected face/animal holdout is substituted. Exact original control draws are unresolved.

inputs.description: Use repeat-averaged original responses at each source population/time window and training-face feature coordinates, with exact coordinate identities/order. Familiar feature targets remain operator scoring inputs; unfamiliar targets are exposed across the original LOOCV folds. Exact source features and response-to-face joins are unresolved.

preprocessing.description: Original decoder uses repeat-averaged firing rates, 50-ms sliding windows stepped 10 ms and source feature standard-deviation scaling. Recover the scaling population, temporal boundaries and neuron/repetition selections; the geometry component full-matrix RMS normalization is not decoder parity.

metric.description: Pearson correlation across actual versus decoded feature coordinates for each face-vector pair, higher is better. Preserve 1,000 unfamiliar values and 1,000 by 36 familiar values at every population/time/control coordinate; do not replace with face-level MSE or absolute correlation.

aggregation.description: Recover original Figure 2d reduction over familiar query folds, faces, cells/populations, time and ten shuffle repetitions and its uncertainty. Retain all per-face/per-fold correlations and all source curves; no new pooled scalar or favorable region/time subset. The 36,000 familiar predictions are not independent faces or animals.

previous_broader_scope.scope: Original familiar/unfamiliar axis-geometry comparison across AM, PR and TP and time, centered on Figure 2b,c with its indispensable source controls; no whole-paper, raw-spike or automatic inactivation requirement.
previous_broader_scope.interpretation: Original Figure 2b,c familiar/unfamiliar encoding-axis geometry and its controls remain a separately named biological reproduction scope. Figure 2e reconstruction, Figure 3c familiarity and Extended Data 10k identity classification are separate source results, not substitute score choices for Figure 2d.

unresolved_requirements: Authenticate the complete Figure 2d neuron/animal/session/face roster, source archive members, feature coordinate order and repetition joins; do not reuse geometry counts as decoder identity.
Recover source feature standard-deviation normalization population, 50-ms/10-ms window boundary/grid, native linear decoder and all ten stimulus-identity-shuffle mappings.
Recover complete original published/reference curves and panel aggregation, including familiar-query dependence; establish calibrated author replay and a justified numerical reproduction criterion.
Predeclare complete-curve improvement, companion-control requirements, meaningful effect and dependence-aware paired inference; no selected region, latency or new aggregate is admissible.
Freeze common source representations, exact author-code package, exposure and cumulative resource/search budgets before activating either assistance condition.

The selected source endpoint retains a complete metric array without an authenticated original scalar reduction. Existing improvement/v1 scalar admission cannot qualify this full-panel comparison; an additive full-panel comparator/admission engine and reviewed complete-support criterion remain required. No new mean, win count or convenient scalar is substituted.
integration_limit: Requires parent-owned reviewed central selection/registry binding; existing old contracts and scope declarations remain unchanged. These candidate files alone do not make the canonical binder select this endpoint.
